counter_definitions.likelihood_evals: One scalar state log-likelihood evaluation. Counts base, initial old, candidate and final updated scores.
counter_definitions.candidate_evals: One candidate score; a subset of likelihood_evals.
counter_definitions.fitness_evals: Same candidate score as candidate_evals, overlapping label; no added work.
counter_definitions.proposal_chromosome_events: One nonelite chromosome selected for its complete G-generation update; historical proposal_attempts unit.
counter_definitions.proposal_candidate_attempts: One generation candidate, same event as candidate_evals.
counter_definitions.rotation_calls: One conditional scalar probability-rotation invocation; not a hardware gate.
counter_definitions.measurement_bit_observations: One scalar Bernoulli bit observation; two per coordinate-bit per candidate.
counter_definitions.probability_entry_updates: Same conditional event as rotation_calls; overlapping work.
counter_definitions.crossover_operations: Explicit crossover absent in this QGPF-like contract; exact zero.
counter_definitions.would_zero_tie_probability_domain: On this stable trajectory, both old/new exp(logpdf) are zero; hypothetical probability-domain tie, not a tie in stable acceptance.
counter_definitions.stable_vs_probability_decision_disagreem: Stable ratio vs old floor-rule evaluated for the same old/new logpdf and same uniform on stable trajectory; NOT differences from historical trajectory.
counter_definitions.base_all_zero_density_steps: All base exp(logpdf) would be zero; stable relative log weights remain defined.
counter_definitions.addition_rule: Candidate/fitness/proposal labels overlap likelihood scoring; rotations overlap probability updates. Never add these labels into a total operation cost.
counter_definitions.unavailable: Physical quantum gate counts/hardware measurements and fully exclusive operation-time attribution: unavailable; classical CPU implementation only.
